decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion fo work.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern wall of the single storey rear extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The existing crossover shall be extended to a maximum width of 3.6m.  A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of this access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 6 - Two parking spaces shall be provided in the front hard standing area prior to the completion of work.
description: Erection of part two storey side/rear extension and single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
